title: MCPTracer eval --json output (v2)
description: Output of `mcptracer eval <session-id> --spec <spec.toml> --json`. v2 adds `schema_version`, a required integer field naming the major version of this schema the document conforms to, so a CI job pinned to a schema can detect the shape it received instead of guessing from content; v1 had no version marker. Bump the filename version and add a new schema on any breaking change; do not edit this file in place once published.

accuracy.description: Fraction of expected + forbidden checks satisfied; 1.0 means every expected call was found and no forbidden call occurred.

reason.description: Failure reason; null when satisfied is true.
